text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition deputies secure motion for parliamentary debate on Israeli settlement in East Jerusalem on Tuesday even though none of the 22 government ministers in parliament voted for the debate.
- King Hussein calls on government to improve pay for judges and ensure independence of judicial system.
- Parliament expected to be dissolved soon and early elections may be held in July or August.
- Israeli defence minister in Jordan on Tuesday to discuss bilateral relations and the peace process.
- King Hussein fortifies the judges to protect democracy and human rights.
- Arafat ends visit after another round of talks with King Hussein on peace process and Jordanian-Palestinian coordination.
